title: Project Avalon overlapping cluster map
method: Editorial many-to-many research lenses; original topic entries and source types retain authority.

clusters.title: Doctors and other medical professionals: combined testimony
clusters.purpose: Bring together doctors, nurses, pharmacists, pathologists, allied professionals and clinicians who become patients.
clusters.preserve: Keep role, first-hand experience, clinical records, professional interpretation and later follow-up distinguishable.
clusters.note: These routes combine named professional accounts, interview descriptions, testimony and an anonymous medical account. Each retains its own source form.

clusters.title: Court cases, legal claims and compensation proceedings
clusters.purpose: Follow access to a remedy from a complaint or filing through the actual proceedings, decisions, appeals and support.
clusters.preserve: Preserve jurisdiction, parties, dates, claim, procedural status, ruling and implementation.

clusters.title: Hearings, inquiries and other government topics
clusters.purpose: Recover parliamentary records, public submissions, executive decisions, regulatory responsibilities and the work that follows.
clusters.preserve: Keep the speaker, venue, date, mandate, question, answer, dissent and outcome attached.

clusters.title: Peer-reviewed papers and other scientific publications
clusters.purpose: Connect journal papers, case reports, reviews, preprints, technical reports and methodological critiques with the questions they investigate.
clusters.preserve: Record the publication type, version, population, methods, endpoints and author conclusions; recover review or retraction history where relevant.
clusters.note: Publication leads below retain the type and version described in the archive. Recover the originating record when checking peer review, revisions, methods or conclusions.

clusters.title: Funeral, embalming, crematorium and cemetery accounts
clusters.purpose: Bring death-care workers’ reports, capacity observations, material findings and cemetery observations into a recoverable field.
clusters.preserve: Distinguish a worker’s account, a relative’s report, a visitor’s observation, service records, tissue analysis and population inference.
clusters.note: The celebrant, funeral-director and embalmer accounts are separated from the cemetery visitor’s observation. Their observations and subsequent research remain connected.

clusters.title: Military operations, research programmes and service conditions
clusters.purpose: Examine military medical records, mandates, procurement, research programmes, command responsibilities and claims about operational involvement.
clusters.preserve: Recover the programme, authority, contract, chain of responsibility and observed conduct for each account.
clusters.note: Service-member experiences, institutional programmes and claims about military involvement are separate strands within this cluster.

clusters.title: Rare public debates and direct exchanges
clusters.purpose: Locate occasions where differing positions can address each other, including debates, cross-examination and substantive public replies.
clusters.preserve: Preserve the actual proposition, question, answer, reply opportunity, format and unresolved difference.
clusters.note: John’s “rare public debates” lens brings together formal debates, direct interviews and hearing exchanges while keeping their formats visible.

clusters.title: Unwarranted mandates and unchallenged emergency measures
clusters.purpose: Use John’s starting lens to examine warrant, necessity, proportionality, alternatives, exemptions, consequences and access to challenge in each measure.
clusters.preserve: Retain the actual rule, affected person, stated objective, evidence, time limit and review route.

clusters.title: Weaponized mass psychology, framing and behavioural influence
clusters.purpose: Investigate how fear, shame, belonging, authority, repetition, targeting and visibility may shape interpretation, choice and participation.
clusters.preserve: Follow particular messages, commissioning, distribution, audience conditions and consequences; apply scrutiny across institutions, media, communities and A.I. systems.
clusters.note: Constructive dialogue provides a useful comparison: the same attention to trust, familiarity and framing can be examined for whether it opens inquiry, narrows it or alters choice.

clusters.title: People’s own accounts and family testimony
clusters.purpose: Preserve lived timelines, help-seeking, uncertainties, personal priorities and the work of relatives or friends.
clusters.preserve: Keep the person’s report, an attributed clinician’s statement and an editor’s interpretation separately recoverable.

clusters.title: Clinical presentations, diagnosis and reassessment
clusters.purpose: Keep specific clinical conditions and diagnostic pathways visible within the wider field.
clusters.preserve: Preserve onset, prior health, tests, differential explanations, severity, function and reassessment.

clusters.title: Treatment, rehabilitation and practical independence
clusters.purpose: Connect diagnostic understanding with accessible care, recovery, mobility and goals chosen by affected people.
clusters.preserve: Keep the proposed intervention, indication, experience, response, adverse effects and follow-up together.

clusters.title: Deaths, mortality patterns, demography and service demand
clusters.purpose: Connect individual records and local observations with appropriately defined population comparisons.
clusters.preserve: Retain baseline, population, age, time, place, registration, exposure history and uncertainty.

clusters.title: Pregnancy, fertility, infant feeding and reproductive health
clusters.purpose: Follow reproductive questions across maternal histories, conception, pregnancy, birth and later infant health.
clusters.preserve: Preserve gestational timing, denominators, prior history, care, infant outcomes and the conditions of follow-up.

clusters.title: Children, development, education and family care
clusters.purpose: Connect childhood health, research participation, development, school access and continuing family responsibilities.
clusters.preserve: Retain age, developmental stage, parental involvement, capacity, school conditions, follow-up and outcomes.

clusters.title: Products, manufacturing, batches and administration
clusters.purpose: Preserve what was actually used, how it was made and handled, and how it was administered.
clusters.preserve: Track product identity, formulation, batch, storage, dose, route, technique and comparability.

clusters.title: Reporting systems, safety surveillance and continuing follow-up
clusters.purpose: Follow a concern from the affected person through recording, analysis, action and later contact.
clusters.preserve: Retain questionnaire fields, free text, coding, revisions, access, signal review and responsibility after closure.
clusters.note: Follow a concern through the actual fields and handoffs: participant report, coding, analysis, response and continuing contact.

clusters.title: Privacy, data access, records and continuity
clusters.purpose: Make the relationship between information rights, research access and continuing memory inspectable.
clusters.preserve: Keep permissions, versions, provenance, linkage, withdrawal, missing fields and repair routes attached.
clusters.note: The public moderation notes are sufficient to study audience changes; the linked private discussion was not accessed.

clusters.title: Commercial incentives, money, funding and allocation
clusters.purpose: Trace costs and financial relationships through research, messaging, product decisions, insurance and care.
clusters.preserve: Preserve payer, beneficiary, contract, incentive, disclosure, resources and who bears delayed or denied support.

clusters.title: Media, censorship, platform algorithms and discoverability
clusters.purpose: Recover what becomes visible, hidden, reframed, circulated or corrected across communication channels.
clusters.preserve: Keep original content, platform action, stated rule, algorithmic claim, access history, consequences and appeal.

clusters.title: Laboratory methods, mechanisms and material identification
clusters.purpose: Connect laboratory observations with reproducible methods and the clinical questions they may inform.
clusters.preserve: Retain sample source, preparation, controls, assays, model, units, specificity and the bridge to lived outcomes.

clusters.title: Study design, comparators, endpoints and causal models
clusters.purpose: Ask which observations would distinguish explanations and which question each design can answer.
clusters.preserve: Preserve selection, exposure, comparator, endpoint, timing, confounders, model assumptions and limits of transfer.

clusters.title: Institutional response, correction and accountable repair
clusters.purpose: Follow notice through investigation, response, changed conduct, continuing help and review.
clusters.preserve: Retain the defect or concern, responsible role, response, resources, revised operation and later outcome.

clusters.title: Community support, dignity, grief and cooperation
clusters.purpose: Preserve what helps people contribute, receive help, disagree, recover and remain connected.
clusters.preserve: Keep personal agency, privacy, grief, practical assistance, reciprocity and room for repair visible.

clusters.title: Work, military service, aviation, sport and return to activity
clusters.purpose: Connect clinical concerns with occupational demands, safety-critical tasks, performance and livelihood.
clusters.preserve: Retain job or activity, exposure, medical fitness, confidentiality, income, rehabilitation and review.

clusters.title: Consent, bodily agency and dependent-care decisions
clusters.purpose: Recover the actual choices and conditions in which decisions are made for oneself or another person.
clusters.preserve: Preserve capacity, information, voluntariness, alternatives, urgency, advocacy and access to review.

clusters.title: Infection, immune function and interacting conditions
clusters.purpose: Connect infection history, immune measurements, underlying conditions and subsequent health.
clusters.preserve: Retain organism, prior condition, timing, exposure, immune finding, treatment and clinical outcome.

clusters.title: Disability, household economics and meaningful life
clusters.purpose: Keep long-term function and the person’s priorities inside the assessment of consequences.
clusters.preserve: Preserve housing, mobility, work, family, care hours, income, companionship, identity and chosen goals.

clusters.title: Research freedom, publication, archives and collective review
clusters.purpose: Follow observations through study design, funding, submission, review, publication, access and later correction.
clusters.preserve: Retain versions, source locations, methods, conflicts, editorial decisions, authorship and opportunities for replication.

clusters.title: A.I. assistance, source recovery and navigable research
clusters.purpose: Make A.I. useful in recovering, comparing and connecting material while preserving the originating object.
clusters.preserve: Keep source versus generated text, access limits, qualifiers, privacy, corrections and the next useful action visible.
clusters.note: A.I.-generated venue identifications and outcome summaries are source suggestions. The next useful operation is recovery of the original recording, minutes and decision.

clusters.title: Veterinary health, environment, biosafety and food systems
clusters.purpose: Keep species, environmental conditions and production systems inside connected health inquiry.
clusters.preserve: Retain species, product, purpose, dose, exposure, monitoring, care, oversight and routes into human decisions.

clusters.title: Process quality, healthy ambiguity and the 1888 property field
clusters.purpose: Keep the process itself corrigible as the scope moves across people, evidence, institutions and consequences.
clusters.preserve: Preserve the question, evaluator assumptions, answer-changing relations, uncertainty, notice, repair and later conduct.
clusters.note: Apply the 1888 intelligence-properties trajectory and all 10+1 ingredients to the cluster map itself: revise a membership when a better relation becomes available.

membership_note: Membership links related investigation topics. Selected archive leads identify actual source forms; publication status and procedural outcomes require their originating records.
